title: Meh
text:
Meh. This thing tries to be everything to everyone and ends op just being mediocre. The surface witht he nubs is difficult to hold and use. Flipping it over gives you another textured surface that is better but not as good as a typical pot holder, and you still have the nubs to deal with for holdign something. It kind of works as a trivet and hot pad, but even there the design is inferior to dedicated trivets and hot pads. It probably works best as a coasted for a pitcher or other large, cold vessel on a hot, humid day, but then a simple plate would work about as well.

Thsi is anot a bad product, but it also is not worthy of rave reviews in my opinion.
